capabilities: convert single or selected HTML files to Markdown via right-click or command
batch convert all HTML files in a folder
translate headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and other elements to Markdown
optionally add title and source YAML frontmatter
skip existing .md files unless overwrite is enabled
extras: Does not execute JavaScript: dynamically generated content, charts, and remote assets are not captured; for JavaScript-heavy pages the docs recommend pre-rendering the HTML in Chrome/Edge before converting. Requires Obsidian 1.6.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert saved HTML files into Markdown notes, especially in bulk, without leaving the vault.

relations.evidence: Convert HTML files to clean Markdown in Obsidian — the reverse of MD to HTML Effectiveness.

summary: HTML-to-Markdown converter that turns .html/.htm files in the vault into .md files, with single, multi-select, and whole-folder batch conversion.
